description: Create or edit a gradient swatch (Swatches panel menu > New Gradient Swatch, Gradient panel): its type (linear or radial) and its colour stops with their locations and midpoints. Creates the gradient when no swatch has the name

stops.description: Colour stops in order, replacing the existing ones (needed when creating)

color.description: Stop colour: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch); a colour, tint or mixed ink, not a gradient

location.description: Location of the stop along the gradient (%)

midpoint.description: Midpoint between this stop and the next (%)

name: set_gradient_swatch
title: Set Gradient Swatch
